title: Cosmic Forge Figure
description: A cracked female figure with a white face and blue energy stands behind an anvil with blue light and sparks coming from it. Her right hand holds a key while her left hand touches blue energy and paint marks cover the stone walls around her.
prompt: a cracked female figure with white face and blue energy stands in ruined stone arches behind a large anvil with bright blue light and sparks rising from it. her right hand holds a large key her left hand touches swirling blue energy. large gears and hourglasses float in a swirling blue and purple cosmic sky above her. an open book and a round compass lie on the stone floor in front. paint marks cover the broken walls.
